title: Senior UI/UX Designer
jobDescription:
About ADA

ADA is the Data and AI Experience Company. Present in 14 markets globally, we build intelligent experiences that power enterprise growth, spanning identity and authentication, personalization, commerce, and data & AI foundations; where every touchpoint earns trust, every interaction creates value, and every decision runs on real-time intelligence, so enterprises can stay ahead and deliver measurable outcomes. Our mission is to build the world's most intelligent growth platform for every client we serve. We work with over 1,500 global brands across CPG, Retail, Telco, BFSI, and Healthcare.

Senior UI/UX Designer – B2B CPaa S Platform

Location: Bangalore

Department: Technology

Reports to: Senior Product Manager

Experience: 5 – 8+ years

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer to own the end-to-end design discipline of our B2B CPaa S (Communications Platform as a Service) product. You'll be turning inherently complex capabilities such as telecom APIs, omnichannel messaging, automation workflows, and analytics, into intuitive, accessible interfaces for highly technical enterprise users. As the primary (or sole) designer partnering with Product and Engineering, you'll be the quality bar for the platform's UX: not just producing screens but ensuring design intent that survives all the way through to what actually ships.

This role carries real ownership of the design system, the platform's information architecture, and the handover discipline that lets engineering build without ambiguity. It suits someone who treats design as a system to be governed, not just a set of deliverables to be produced, and who proactively flags risk, documents decisions, and holds the line on quality under delivery pressure.

Key Responsibilities & What Success Looks Like

  • Complex workflow simplification: Design flows, wireframes, and prototypes that make CPaa S configuration approachable: things like journey creation builders, bulk Whats App and RCS setup, chatbot/automation flows, number provisioning, and API-driven console dashboards. You reduce cognitive load through progressive disclosure and role-based views rather than exposing every option at once.

  • Developer experience (DX) focus: Partner closely with product managers & engineers so that consoles, API-configuration screens, documentation surfaces, and dashboards are logically structured and frictionless for a technical audience. You understand that in a CPaa S product, technically savvy users are the primary consumers.

  • End-to-end ownership: Own design across the platform, from discovery and research through to shipped UI, including modules beyond your direct assignments. You're comfortable as the primary or sole designer, operating with high autonomy, and can speak to the platform's overall UX state at any time.

  • Proactive risk management: Maintain a working view of UX debt and gaps across the platform, flagging risks in planning and reviews before they become downstream problems.

  • Handover rigor: Produce self-explanatory, fully annotated handovers (all states, edge cases, responsive behaviour, design tokens) that require no back-and-forth with engineering and stay engaged through build so shipped work matches design intent.

  • Design system governance: Build, scale, and enforce a robust, component-driven design system (tokens, patterns, naming conventions, auto-layout discipline) that stays consistent across the CPaa S portal, analytics dashboards, and any mobile surfaces, operated as a living standard, not a one-off project.

  • Information architecture ownership: Own and maintain the platform's IA (sitemaps, navigation, content taxonomy, labelling) as new features ship, treating it as a version-controlled artifact rather than a one-time exercise.

  • Research & data-informed decisions: Plan and run usability tests and heuristic evaluations and use product analytics and enterprise-client feedback to justify design choices on first principles rather than aesthetic preference alone.


    Cross-functional leadership: Act as the voice of the customer, advocate for user-centered design, defend design decisions to executive stakeholders, and mentor other designers within the agile product team.

Requirements

  • 5–8+ years in UI/UX design, ideally shipping high-quality B2B, Saa S, or enterprise tech products.

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of complex, multi-user, or data-heavy products (data visualization, system configuration, dashboards; not marketing sites or consumer apps).

jobDescription:

 ADA is a leading data and artificial intelligence (AI) company that designs and executes integrated digital, analytics, and marketing solutions. We operate in 11 markets in Asia and partner with leading brands to drive their data and digital maturity.

We are seeking a Senior Automation QA Lead with 5–10 years of experience to lead automation initiatives across UI and API testing. This role requires strong technical ownership, test strategy design, and mentoring of junior QA engineers while ensuring quality across complex, scalable systems. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Define and implement testing processes, methodologies, and standards to ensure consistency and quality across projects. 
  • Understand the application/domain end to end, take ownership of group of applications for Quality using existing automation frameworks & solutions. 
  • Build deeper understanding of product/application & proactively identify areas to improve quality of product through automation. 
  • Drive the team to improve efficiency of automation & demonstrate continuous improvement. 
  • Lead end-to-end, integration, regression, smoke, and sanity testing efforts. 
  • Mentor and guide junior QA engineers on best practices and automation standards. 
  • Work with the Software Development manager and product management team to develop the overall strategy and roadmap for test to meet organisational objectives. Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and stakeholders to ensure quality alignment. 
  • Continually seek ways to improve and enhance the quality assurance process and the process of application development and maintenance 
  • Proactively validates requirements for completeness, accuracy, and potential quality risks related to data integrity and system security. 

About the Job and Duties  

  • Design, develop, and maintain advanced automated test frameworks for UI (Playwright, Selenium) and API testing (Rest Assured). 
  • Technically lead 2-3 members QA team with hands-on & deliver results. 
  • Create documentation, training materials, and guidelines to support the testing practice and promote best practices. 
  • Create and execute automated tests for RESTful APIs, validating requests, responses, headers, payloads, and data integrity. 
  • Define and maintain test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test data. 
  • Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines and improve test execution efficiency. 
  • Analyze test results, provide quality metrics, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. 
  • Identify root causes of defects and work proactively on preventive quality measures. 
  • Testing Across Devices to Cloud 
  • Develop strategies for testing across a variety of platforms, including mobile devices, web applications, and cloud-based solutions.   
  • Select appropriate tools and frameworks to support testing in diverse environments and technologies.   
  • Implement automation frameworks, regression testing strategies, and CI/CD pipelines to streamline the testing process.   
  • Identify the test capability required to meet current and future demand in specialised technical disciplines 

Required Skills & Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
  • 5–10 years of experience in QA Automation. 
  • Strong hands-on experience with: 
  • Playwright (Java Script/Type Script or Python) 
  • Selenium Web Driver (Java, Python, or C#) 
  • Rest Assured for API automation 
  • Postman for manual API testing 
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP protocols. 
  • Experience with test frameworks (JUnit, Test NG, etc.). 
  • Strong exposure to CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI). 
  • Proficiency with Git and version control workflows. 
  • Excellent debugging, analytical, leadership, and communication skills. 

Good to Have 

  • Performance testing experience (JMeter, Gatling, k6). 
  • Experience in test architecture design for large-scale systems. 
  • Familiarity with security testing concepts and tools like Burpsuite. 

Education 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. 
  • Advanced certifications in testing or cloud technologies are a plus.
